name: Cookie
summary: Round golden chocolate chip cookie, optionally with a bite taken out, for snack, bakery and dessert scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cookie rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~380 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: bite
params.note: a bite taken out of the top right edge

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
